text:
Biografi Nunganggit Barzanji

Ieu Kitab Dianggit Ku Kersana “Sayyid Zaenal ‘Abidin Ja’far Bin Hasan Al-Husaeni Asy-Syahzuri Al-Barzanji”. Mantena Lahir Di Madinah Al-Munawwaroh, Dinten Kemis Awal Dzulhijjah 1128h/1716m, Wafat Kaping 4 Sya’ban 1177h/1763m Dinten Salasa. Dipendem Di Baqe’.

Rundayan Mantena Ngarunday Dugi Ka Rosululloh Saw, Nyaeta Sayyid Zaenal ‘Abidin Ja’far Bin Sayyid Hasan Bin Sayyid Abdi Al-Karim Bin Sayyid Muhammad Bin Sayyid Sayid Rosul Bin Sayyid Abdi Al-Syed Bin Sayyid Abdi Al-Rosul Bin Sayyid Qolandar Bin Sayyid Abdi Al-Syed Bin Sayyid Isa Bin Sayyid Husain Bin Sayyid Bayazid Bin Sayyid Abdi Al-Karim Bin Sayyid Isa Bin Sayyid Ali Bin Sayyid Yusuf Bin Sayyid Mansur Bin Sayyid Abdi Al-Aziz Bin Sayyid Abdillah Bin Sayyid Ismail Bin Sayyid Musa Al-Kazim Bin Sayyid Ja’far Al-Shodiq Bin Sayyid Sayyid Baqir Bin Sayyid Zaenal ‘Abidin Bin Sayyidina ‘Ali Ra Bin Sayyidatina Fatimah Az-Zahra.

Sapanjang Yuswana Tialit Keneh Mantena Ageung Sareng Kaelmuan, Waktosna Pinuh Dianggo Nalar Sareng Maham Alqur’an Katut Hadits, Kacarioskeun Yen Nalar 30 Juzna Ka Syekh Ismail Al-Yamani, Teras Di Taseh Ka Syekh Yususf Al-Asho’idi Teras Diajar Tafsir Qur’an Sareng Hadits Sareng Elmu Nu Sanesna Ka Ulama Di Masjid Nabawi,. Diantara Guru Guruna Nyaeta Syekh Athaillah Bin Ahmad Al-Azhari, Syekh Abdul Wahab Ath-Thanthawi, Syekh Ahmad Al-‘Asybuli Sareng Seueur Keneh Nu Sanesna.

Mantena Ulama Nu Di Akui Nyagara Elmuna, Malih Dina Yuswa Ka 31 Tahun Mantena Janten Mufti Syafi’iyah Di Madinah Oge Kalebet Khotib Di Masjid Nabawi. Syekh Ja’far Kasohor Kasep Tur Sae Suantena, Sae Akhlak Budi Parangina, Kapercanten Ku Masyarakatna, Tur Kasohor Nyagara Elmuna. Malihan Seueur Kitab-Kitab Anggitan Mantena. Di Antawisna ; Mukhtashor Dlou-Ul Wahhaj Fi Qishotil Isro Wal Mi’raj, Alghusnul Wardi Fi Akhbari Sayyidil Mahdi, Ar-Roudul Mi’thor, An-Nafhud Darriji Fil Fathil Jannati, Sareng Seueur Deui Nu Sanesna.
